skill.name: tiktok-shop-ad-library-analytics
skill.description: Research TikTok ads alongside TikTok Shop products and stores using PipiAds ad and TikTok Shop analytics tools.
skill.summary: Compare TikTok ad creative patterns with TikTok Shop product and store metrics.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: Markdown tool names, homepage links, and environment variable declarations do not execute commands or disclose credentials. The setup installs an unaudited MCP package, passes it the API key, and directs users to a separate domain for billing without corroborating its ownership. Research calls consume credits without a documented spending cap, and no evidence of prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: Global installation of an unreviewed MCP package
remediation.suggestion: Verify the pinned package, dependencies, and lifecycle scripts. Require explicit consent before installation and prefer an isolated, unprivileged runtime over a global install.

remediation.issue: API key passed to the external MCP process
remediation.suggestion: Provide a dedicated, restricted key if supported. Give it only to the verified MCP process and keep it out of chat, logs, and tool output.

remediation.issue: Separate key and billing domain lacks corroboration
remediation.suggestion: Link to provider documentation that confirms the key and billing domain. Ask users to verify the domain before entering credentials or payment information.

remediation.issue: Billable research has no documented spending limit
remediation.suggestion: Agree on a credit cap before the first call. Limit search results and detail requests, and ask for approval before exceeding the cap.

content.user_title: Analyze TikTok Ads and Shop Performance
content.value_statement: Separate ad and shop reports make it hard to see which creative patterns appear alongside stronger product sales. Use PipiAds to compare TikTok ad examples with TikTok Shop product and store metrics.
actual_capabilities: Search TikTok ad creatives by niche and retrieve details for selected ads.
Look up product records through the ad research tools.
Search TikTok Shop products and inspect sales, gross merchandise value, pricing, and momentum when reported.
Find TikTok Shop stores and review their records to compare market positioning.
Summarize creative patterns alongside product and store performance in the same niche.
limitations: Live lookups require a configured PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key.
Search results and detail requests can consume PipiAds account credits.
Ad and shop comparisons do not establish that an ad caused sales.
The skill is not intended for Facebook-only research, cross-platform product discovery, or TikTok content research without shop data.

use_cases.title: Find creative patterns for a campaign
use_cases.description: Review TikTok ads in a niche and compare recurring creative approaches with the shop products found in that niche.

use_cases.title: Evaluate products for a shop assortment
use_cases.description: Compare reported sales, pricing, and momentum for TikTok Shop products in a specific market and price range.

use_cases.title: Benchmark competing stores
use_cases.description: Compare store records and product selections to understand how competitors position their offers.

prompt_templates.title: Find a few ad examples
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to three TikTok ads for reusable water bottles in the United States over the past 30 days. Summarize the opening approach of each ad.

prompt_templates.title: Compare product performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare products in a price band.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five TikTok Shop water bottles priced from $15 to $35 in the United States. Compare reported sales, pricing, and gross merchandise value for the past 30 days.

prompt_templates.title: Benchmark shop positioning
prompt_templates.scenario: Upper intermediate: Compare a small group of stores.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare up to three TikTok Shop stores selling reusable bottles in the United States. Use a 30-day window and describe price positioning. Mark missing metrics and ask before expanding the search.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creative patterns with shop results
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine ad, product, and store records.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TikTok ads and TikTok Shop records for reusable bottles priced from $15 to $35 in the United States. Use a 30-day window and a budget of 12 credits. Separate verified product matches from category comparisons. Do not infer that any ad caused sales.

output_examples.input: Find three reusable bottle ads and compare them with shop products in the same niche.
output: Illustrative result: Two ads demonstrated a leakproof lid, and one showed how the bottle fit in a cup holder.
The products returned by the shop search were priced from $18 to $29.
No verified product match was found, so the comparison stays at the category level.

output_examples.input: Compare two TikTok Shop stores selling reusable bottles over the past 30 days.
output: Illustrative result: Store A featured lower-priced single bottles, while Store B featured higher-priced bundles.
Store A had higher reported unit sales in the sample.
Store B had no reported gross merchandise value, so the stores could not be ranked on that metric.

best_practices: Set a category, region, price band, and time window before searching.
Give a credit budget and cap the number of search results and detail requests.
Separate verified product matches from niche comparisons and label missing metrics.
anti_patterns: Running broad searches and opening every result without checking the credit cost.
Treating a shared product category as proof that a specific ad promoted a specific shop listing.
Requesting Facebook-only research or cross-platform comparisons with this TikTok workflow.

faq.question: What do I need for live research?
faq.answer: Configure the PipiAds MCP server and provide the API key through the client environment. Do not paste the key into a prompt.

faq.question: Does research use paid credits?
faq.answer: The skill documents one credit per search result and one per detail request. Detail requests are free if queried within three days.

faq.question: Which shop metrics can I compare?
faq.answer: Compare sales, gross merchandise value, prices, and product momentum when the provider returns those metrics.

faq.question: Can this skill show which ad caused a sale?
faq.answer: No. It can compare creative patterns and shop metrics, but the documented tools do not provide causal attribution.

faq.question: Can I use this for Facebook ads or organic TikTok content only?
faq.answer: No. This workflow focuses on TikTok ads alongside TikTok Shop product and store data.

faq.question: Can this skill publish ads or change shop listings?
faq.answer: No. The documented tools search and retrieve research records. They do not publish ads or edit listings.
